name: Mill Creek Generating Station gas lateral
monitor_reason: No concrete step and no data center tie. The only pipe source is a 2021 engineering cost study; the pipe is not tied to data centers by any source.
researcher_notes: Not an existing row under another name. The 2021 engineering study, filed in the Mill Creek 5 case, prices a pipeline of about 0.92 miles, in 12-inch and 16-inch options, from the existing 26-inch Texas Gas line to the Mill Creek plant, with a new interconnect station. It is a cost estimate for the Mill Creek combined cycle units, with no permit, contract or construction award for the pipe. The July 2026 Mill Creek 6 update names data centers as the driver for that unit but does not mention a gas pipeline or lateral. A web search found no source saying the lateral was built or approved for Mill Creek 5, which is under construction. DataCenter stays blank. Sponsor would be Louisville Gas and Electric. Revisit if a filing or Texas Gas release shows the lateral was applied for, awarded or built.
